patterns.name: emotion_to_block_to_action
patterns.shape: Cups/emotional card -> blocked/decision card -> action/movement card
patterns.read: Feeling is present, but the middle card explains why it does or does not become behavior. Never skip the bridge.

patterns.name: ideal_to_disruption_to_rebuild
patterns.read: The old form is challenged; distinguish restoring the old ideal from building a healthier new form.

patterns.name: skill_to_overload_to_adjustment
patterns.shape: Pentacles/competence -> Ten of Wands/pressure -> Temperance/Four of Swords
patterns.read: Capacity created responsibility; guidance is sustainable redesign, not generic rest.

patterns.name: uncertainty_to_truth
patterns.shape: Moon/Seven of Cups/Two of Swords -> Justice/Ace of Swords/Sun
patterns.read: The spread moves from ambiguity toward verification/clarity. Do not fill the uncertain phase with invented facts.

patterns.name: attachment_to_release
patterns.shape: Devil/Six of Cups/Four of Pentacles -> Death/Eight of Cups/World
patterns.read: Identify what is being held and what release changes; do not assume release means loss rather than maturation.

patterns.name: spark_without_capacity
patterns.shape: Ace/Knight of Wands or Cups -> reversal/stalemate/practical constraint
patterns.read: Interest or feeling can be genuine while capacity/follow-through is weak.
